Lively week practice for pickup lanes
This section sets out what applies on every shift

Companion Animal Travel Desk Safety and Claims Practice
The purpose of this section is to protect travelers, animals, and staff by setting a careful standard for handling bookings, transfers, and incident reporting at Aurelia Skyways. The Companion Animal Travel Desk must keep safety ahead of speed at all times, with calm attention to each animal's condition and each traveler's instructions. Staff must confirm care notes before acceptance, record any service change in the desk ledger, and share concerns with the senior coordinator without delay. A traveler should be advised in plain language when a carrier, document, or route detail needs review, and the desk should never rely on memory alone when a written record is available.

When an animal shows signs of stress, the staff member must slow the process, separate the check from the queue if needed, and request support from the responsible handler. If a minor injury occurs during handling or transfer, the report must be completed at once and the traveler informed with courtesy and clarity. <<FACT F113>> The desk must preserve all related notes, including witness comments and the condition of the carrier, because a clear file helps later review and fair treatment. Staff should avoid debate at the counter and instead move the conversation to a private space when emotions rise.

If an animal is reported missing during transit, the desk must begin the search steps at once, contact the relevant operating team, and continue to document each action in the ledger. <<FACT F120>> The traveler must receive steady updates, and the staff member should remain respectful even when the situation is tense. Any recovered animal should be checked for distress before handover, and any follow-up care should be arranged before the case is closed.

All records, whether routine or exceptional, must be complete, legible, and ready for review, because careful documentation supports safe service and honest accountability. For guidance on any uncertain case, contact the senior coordinator or the duty manager through the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
